terra.problem: The imagined people passing the remark from one to the next add an action the passage does not describe.
“Wrong spot” uses “wrong” about the baker’s answer.
The passage does not establish that nobody at the cross says Isaiah’s name. It simply does not report anyone saying it.
“Everybody else is standing around” goes beyond the text, which says only that some people were standing there.
The passage does not establish that nobody sets the sponge down. It describes the man holding it up.
The passage does not specify that the others address the man with the sponge or tell him to stop.
The passage does not specify that the others address the man with the sponge. It also does not establish that nobody in the crowd asks for more wine.
The passage does not establish that nobody in the crowd asks to bring Jesus down. It reports what the others say.
The guess about what the guards’ training covered adds a detail the passage does not give.
“A long walk” assumes how the women traveled from Galilee. The passage does not say they walked.
